definitions: A subculture and art movement that emerged in the Bronx, New York City, in the 1970s. It includes elements such as rapping, DJing, breakdancing, and graffiti art.
A musical genre that developed as part of hip hop culture, characterized by rhythmic spoken word (rapping) over a beat.
examples: She's a big fan of hip hop music.
The origins of hip hop can be traced back to the Bronx.
